decision.explanation: The provided sources describe two distinct individuals named Friedrich II. von Parsberg. Document 1 refers to Friedrich II. von Parsberg (died 1461), who served as a diocesan bishop and specifically as the Bishop of Eichstätt. Document 2 refers to Friedrich II. von Parsberg (1480–1543), who served as the Prince-Bishop of Augsburg and later as the Count of Astarac. These roles are clearly attributed to their respective referents in the original texts. Complementary answers are preserved without conflating the two distinct individuals.
